profile.ja: 五車学園で学ぶ学生対魔忍。陽遁の術という火遁に連なる術を使う。陽遁の術の潜在能力は凄まじいと言われ、かつてこの力を発現させた対魔忍は太陽にも匹敵する熱を発し、数里を焼き尽くし自身も焼滅したという古い文献が残っている。しかし現在の彼女の術は発光による目潰しや小さな火球を放つ程度で、戦闘では体術や武器による攻撃をメインとしている。一時的に術の出力を上げることは可能だが、その場でぶっ倒れる事もあり、あくまで最後の手段。本人は底抜けに明るい性格で、周囲からは「暑苦しいけど心強い」と評価されている。ただ、彼女の陽光を浴び続けると日焼けをするので、クラスメイトの女子達は訓練の前に日焼け止めをしっかり塗りこんでいるが、当の本人は一切気にせず全身こんがりと焼けている。肉付きの良い体型と、男女関係なく近い距離感で男子達からは密かに人気がある。「モテるために日焼けしたい」と彼女に日サロ役を頼み、なんとか接点を持とうとする男子が後を絶たないが、鈍感な彼女にそんな意図は一切伝わらず、本人は「友達の役に立てて嬉しい」としか思っていない様子。
profile.en: She is a student Taimanin at Gosha Academy, using the art of Yangdon, a technique related to fire manipulation. The potential of Yangdon is said to be immense, with ancient literature stating that a Taimanin who once wielded this power was able to produce heat rivaling the sun, burning everything in sight, including herself. However, her current abilities only allow her to create blindingly bright lights or small fireballs, and she primarily relies on martial arts and weapon-based attacks in combat. She can temporarily increase her technique's output, but this can also cause her to collapse, making it a last resort. She has a bright and cheerful personality, earning her the evaluation of being "hot-headed but reliable" from those around her. Her classmates, especially the girls, apply sunscreen before training due to her intense sunlight, but she herself doesn't mind and has a nicely tanned body. Her athletic build and friendly demeanor have made her popular among the boys, who often try to get close to her, but she remains oblivious to their intentions, thinking she's just being a good friend.

text.ja: 日ノ出陽葵だよ、よろしく！　同い年なのに、隊長なんてすごいよね、私も頑張らないと！
text.en: I'm Hinode Himari, nice to meet you! You're our captain, even though we're the same age - that's really impressive! I'll have to work hard too!

text.ja: 私の忍術は陽遁の術、つまり太陽に匹敵するような熱を操れるんだよ。そこまで力が強くて、使いこなせれば――の話だけどねっ
text.en: My ninja art is Yangdon, which means I can manipulate heat that's comparable to the sun. If I can master it, it could be incredibly powerful, but that's still a topic for discussion.

text.ja: 昔は本当に、太陽くらいの熱を放つ使い手がいたらしいんだよね。強力すぎて、敵を焼き尽くしたものの、自分も燃え尽きちゃったって話だけど
text.en: Apparently, there was a Taimanin in the past who could really produce heat on par with the sun. They were so strong that they burned their enemies to a crisp, but they also ended up burning themselves out.

text.ja: いまの私だと、光の球で目潰ししたり、火の玉で敵を焼いたりするのが精いっぱいかな。使うと倒れちゃう、最後の手段でもあるしね
text.en: For now, I can only create small fireballs or blinding lights. Using my technique can be exhausting, and it's usually my last resort.

text.ja: 陽遁の術はまだまだ修行中だから、普段はこれ。振り回せるハンマーとか、あとは体術で戦う感じだよ。式神にも協力してもらってね
text.en: Since I'm still training in Yangdon, I usually rely on this hammer I can wield or my martial arts skills. My shikigami also helps me out.

text.ja: すっごい日焼けでしょ？　力は弱くても、やっぱり太陽の力だからね。この光は日光と同じで、近くにいるとすぐ日焼けしちゃうんだ
text.en: I get really tanned, don't I? Even though my powers are still weak, they're based on the sun's energy, so the light I produce is similar to sunlight. If you're too close, you'll get sunburned in no time.

text.ja: クラスの男子たちが、日焼けしたいって、よく術を頼みに来るんだよ。訓練にもなるし、一石二鳥ってやつだよね
text.en: The boys in my class often ask me to use my technique on them, saying they want to get tanned. It's a good way to train, and it kills two birds with one stone, I suppose.

text.ja: 合同訓練だと、女子は日焼けが気になるみたい。私は気にしても仕方ないし、日焼けするのも好きだから、むしろお得なんだけどね～
text.en: When we have joint training sessions, the girls get worried about getting sunburned. I don't really mind, and I actually like getting tanned, so it's a win-win for me.

text.ja: こんなにザーメンかけられたら、日焼け肌が真っ白になっちゃう……あんっ♪　もうっ、またこんなにぃ……はぁっ、すっごく熱いよぉ……
text.en: If I get covered in this much semen, my tanned skin will turn completely white... Ah, it's so hot...

text.ja: んぅっ、あぁっ、かけてぇっ！　あっついザーメン、いっぱい……キミがいつもかけるから、クセになっちゃったんだよぉ
text.en: Ah, ah, it feels so good! The warm semen, it's all over me... You always do this to me, and I've gotten used to it.
